correctness.rationale: Modulo 5, f has 0->1->2->4->0 and 3->3. Hensel on x^3-x+1 gives the unique alpha congruent 3 mod25. The fourth return contracts the other balls and is an isometry on B; g_prime(alpha)=16 mod25 and g_second(alpha)=0 mod5 imply v_5(g(x)-x)=k+1 on S_k. The derivative congruences and fivefold Taylor lifting increment displacement valuation by exactly one at every iteration; reduction modulo 5 first gives multiplicative period four, so the finite shell has exactly 4*5^(n-k-1) states and one cycle. Fresh independent functional graph enumeration for n=1..5 confirmed all lengths and basin; general statement follows from lifting, not this finite check.
